coverage_notes: Binding was independently recomputed for all 43 review artifacts. The framed aggregate is 3a32f0f33a8d3aeb4446e88d724f717eda276ba0a518f86e73e12735259cc4aa; artifact paths, byte counts, candidate identity, physical oracle identity and corpus candidate binding are mutually consistent.

All 39 text artifacts were read in full. The three JPEG fixtures were parsed marker by marker, and the retained SQLite oracle was independently checked against its header, schema, physical-page, relationship, record-digest and inventory claims.

The digest contract was independently reimplemented from the prose and reproduced the minimum frames, fixture record digests, minimal and full inventory digests, NULL-versus-empty vectors and bilingual empty-fixture inventories without ambiguity.

The corrected JPEG grammar admits only 8-bit SOF0 with the fixed JFIF 1.02 prefix. SOF1, SOF2 and all other frame classes are rejected; component coverage, DQT/DHT references, DRI/RST sequencing, single EOI, no trailer and dimension limits are closed. Progressive missing-final-scan acceptance is therefore structurally impossible.

The retained JPEG inventory is exactly two 2x2 canonical SOF0 fixtures plus one 2000x2000 dimension-ceiling fixture. The 59 JPEG negative cases and their byte identities were recomputed in memory, including explicit SOF1 and SOF2 rejection.

The generated corpus contains 428 identity-bound cases: 207 logical-type, 67 CHECK, 59 semantic, 36 structure and 59 JPEG grammar cases. The separate 11-case POSIX matrix and temporary limit probes remain generator-bound by documented design.

Hostile SQLite input, schema identity, DBSTAT page closure, index parity, logical storage classes, UTF-8 and NUL policy, duplicate identities, foreign keys, semantic closure and checked resource limits were challenged without finding a contract or evidence gap.

Simulator-bound reproduction commands were not re-executed during the read-only review. Their retained inputs, outputs, identities and evidence were checked for internal consistency; minimum-OS, production implementation, large runtime round trips, UTType declaration and release evidence remain explicit downstream gates rather than package claims.
